boilerplate.company_overview: Converged Networks, LLC is a leading provider of enterprise networking solutions specializing in Ruckus, Extreme, and Ubiquiti equipment. With extensive experience in E-rate funded projects, we understand the unique requirements and compliance needs of educational institutions.
why_choose_us: Authorized partner for Ruckus, Extreme, and Ubiquiti Networks
Extensive experience with E-rate compliance and documentation
Professional installation and ongoing support services
Competitive pricing and flexible payment options
Dedicated project management and technical support
boilerplate.warranty_support: All equipment includes manufacturer warranty and our team provides ongoing technical support to ensure optimal performance of your network infrastructure.
boilerplate.terms: Pricing valid for 30 days. Payment terms net 30. Installation scheduled upon receipt of E-rate funding commitment letter.
